verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. CLAUDE-G20CAT-V1-SF1 is landed by content, not by placeholder: slashJoinerVerbatim is == equal to live G20 v1 at 209 characters and surfacesInOrder at eight ordered members, and the three substrings I measured absent from v1 — 'not eight live-cell members', 'invented corpus-class ids' and 'stays one slash-joined surface set' — are all present in v2. All six keys of the live class object are now carried and every one is == equal, so the uncarried-source-key set is empty and the artifact meets the same structural-completeness standard on which I accepted the G22 sibling. The repair carries no regression: all six pre-existing class fields and both doesNot and whatIsNotAuthored are == identical to v1, so purpose's claim that the measurement is otherwise unchanged is exactly true. The self-description was updated rather than left stale, which was this repair's natural failure mode — whatIsAuthored and the authorityClaim now enumerate all five quoted fields. Every cited digest measures equal with zero mismatches, recordedInputs.HEAD agrees with the top-level head and live HEAD, the predecessor block pins v1 and my verdict at digests that both measure equal and states the 0/1 standing accurately, v1 is unmoved at e1311c45 with its version number not reused, closure remains structurally unavailable with the pinned join still holding both obligations at leftoverDesign true, no SDK API, envelope or D9 value appears, one class with the live id means no id is coined, and the subject did not move. Five further refutations of my own — a cosmetic repair, a quiet change to a carried string, the catalog violating the rule it now carries, a stale self-description, and an overstated predecessor standing — all failed against live bytes.
